item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
Added

  • Multiple accounts. Connect and manage several Apple Ads accounts in one place, and switch between them instantly from the sidebar. Each account’s data and credentials stay fully isolated, and accounts with more than one org get a built-in scope switcher.
  • Bulk negative keywords. Add several negative keywords at once instead of one at a time.
  • Open-ended date ranges. Report on everything “since a date,” in addition to the preset ranges.

Changed

  • A completely redesigned interface. A flatter, faster, more consistent look across the sidebar, tables, toolbar, and dialogs — refined typography (SF Pro), pill-style controls, tinted status badges, and cleaner monoline icons, with new onboarding and paywall to match.
  • Reworked date and filter controls, grouped into clear, consistent dropdown pills.

Improved

  • Gentler error handling. When a metrics load fails, ADSwift now shows a quiet banner with Retry / Details / Report instead of interrupting you with a modal.
  • Clearer match-type controls and consistent action buttons across the app’s sheets and dialogs.
